method: Port of ML/REGRESSION (LinearRegression, LinearRegressionWithoutIntercept, QuadraticRegression), ML/RANSAC (RANSACModel, RANSACModelLinear, RANSACModelQuadratic, RANSAC) and ANALYSIS/OPENSWATH/MRMRTNormalizer, with the RandomShuffler class of MATH/MathFunctions.h that RANSAC draws through. The GTE fits (ApprHeightLine2, LinearSystem 2x2/3x3 inverses) are transcribed operation for operation. Every class-test literal is transcribed; an executed differential against the Linux x86_64 Release install covers every public member.
evidence_tier: tier 1 (executed differential: 128 cases, 2110 records, Linux x86_64 Release install openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576 on ibminode06) for every public member of the eight headers, bit for bit except LinearRegression getTValue/getLower/getUpper (relative 1e-12); tier 3 (class-test literals of six class tests); tier 4 (published t table, hand-derived binned coverage, a synthetic RANSAC acceptance case, Rust-only preconditions)

oracle.sdk: Linux x86_64 Release install /ceph/ibmi/abi/oliver/opt/openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576, x86_64-conda-linux-gnu-g++ (conda-forge gcc 14.4.0-4) 14.4.0, flags -O3 -DNDEBUG -std=gnu++23 -fPIC -fvisibility=hidden -fvisibility-inlines-hidden -mssse3 -ffp-contract=off -fopenmp
oracle.reproduction: remote_run.sh runs the driver twice in fresh processes; records, stdout, stderr and exit code were byte-identical (results/differ.txt empty).
oracle.time_interposition: The driver defines time() with default visibility and links with -rdynamic; results/time_export.txt shows it in the dynamic symbol table, and each removeOutliersRANSAC case that reaches RANSAC records exactly one call (time_calls 1), so the RANSAC that libOpenMS constructs reads the case's value.
oracle.comparison: Every double as its IEEE-754 bit pattern, integers and booleans exactly, exceptions as 'the port also fails'. LinearRegression t_value, lower and upper within 1e-12 relative (bound fixed before the first measurement): Boost evaluates the quantile in long double, the port polishes statrs's AS 64/109 inversion with Newton steps in f64.
oracle.measured: All records bit-identical except the t-quantile records: at most 5.6e-14 relative for t_value and 5.7e-13 for lower/upper (linregw:quad_noisy). statrs's unpolished inverse_cdf was 2.4e-13 relative from Boost on t_value and 3.2e-12 on lower, which failed the bound and led to the Newton polish.

external_reference_note: The C++ driver, the dataset generator and the run script live outside this repository under ../oracle/O4b-ransac so that no C++ is committed here. results/hashes.txt records the sha256 of the driver, the inputs, the built driver, libOpenMS.so and the oracle output as they were on ibminode06.
